FGT.Authoring.Element.StatDeltaHint: Adds to or multiplies a stat, with an optional floor.
FGT.Authoring.Element.MaxDeltaHint: Changes a pool's MAXIMUM — Health, Sustainability — not its current value.
FGT.Authoring.Element.MovDeltaHint: Changes MOV. Slow halves it; a floor stops it reaching zero.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RangeDeltaHint: Changes how far the Unit can reach.
FGT.Authoring.Element.SizeStepHint: Changes how many panels the Unit stands on, as a footprint delta.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ZonBonusHint: Widens this Servant's Master's ZON. `stacks` decides whether two sources add.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RankShiftHint: Moves a rank up or down — a parameter, an ability's rank, or a whole grade.
FGT.Authoring.Element.CheckModifierHint: Makes a named check easier or harder.
FGT.Authoring.Element.AutoSucceedHint: A named check succeeds without rolling, optionally only sometimes.
FGT.Authoring.Element.TableOverrideHint: Rolls a different table for a check, or forces one outright.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RollAdjustmentHint: Caps or shifts the result of a roll.
FGT.Authoring.Element.BlockLuckChecksHin: Removes the Luck Check option entirely — not a penalty, a removal.
FGT.Authoring.Element.AttackerPropertyTi: A bonus keyed on a property of whoever is attacking.
FGT.Authoring.Element.AttackFirstHint: Attack before the Unit that just declared an attack on you.
FGT.Authoring.Element.TargetingModifierH: Changes what this Unit may legally target.
FGT.Authoring.Element.TargetabilityModif: Changes who may legally target the Units around this one.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ForceTargetHint: Forces an attack onto a particular Unit.
FGT.Authoring.Element.DecoyHint: Pulls attacks meant for others onto this Unit, within a radius.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ForbidReactionHint: Takes rungs of the reaction ladder away — Evade, Block, Counter.
FGT.Authoring.Element.AutoCounterHint: Counters automatically when a named event happens.
FGT.Authoring.Element.WeakPointHint: Declares a weak point on this Unit — where it can be hit harder.
FGT.Authoring.Element.KnockbackHint: Forces a Unit out of the way when this one moves into it.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ApplicationChanceH: Shifts how likely an effect is to LAND, not what it does once it has.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ImmunityHint: Cannot be affected by the named effects at all.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ImmunityDowngradeH: Turns an immunity into a resistance, or one effect into a milder one.
FGT.Authoring.Element.DurationExtensionH: Lengthens or shortens the effects applied to or by this Unit.
FGT.Authoring.Element.SuppressForeignEff: Negates effects caused by Units outside this fight — negated, not removed.
FGT.Authoring.Element.SuppressHint: Switches off a named scope of effect while this applies.
FGT.Authoring.Element.EffectVisibilityHi: Decides who can see an effect this Unit carries.
FGT.Authoring.Element.OnEventHint: Runs something when a named event happens — the general-purpose trigger.
FGT.Authoring.Element.AuraHint: A radius around this Unit that changes the Units inside it.
FGT.Authoring.Element.CompulsionHint: Forces a Unit to act against a particular target — Berserk, Decoy's pull.
FGT.Authoring.Element.GrantedAbilityHint: Hands the bearer an ability it does not otherwise have.
FGT.Authoring.Element.OfferAbilityUseHin: Offers an ability at a named event, rather than granting it outright.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ReplaceAbilityHint: Swaps one ability for another while this applies.
FGT.Authoring.Element.OptionalCostHint: Offers a spend at a timing window — the Unit may pay, it is never charged.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RevivalSourceHint: A way back from zero Health, with a stated order when a Unit has several.
FGT.Authoring.Element.SustainabilityGain: Gains Sustainability when a named event happens.
FGT.Authoring.Element.VariantOverrideHin: Grants the Unit its own alternate summon-variant shape.
FGT.Authoring.Element.DisguiseHint: Makes this Unit read as something it is not.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RevealPositionHint: Shows where Units carrying a named effect are, through Fog of War.
FGT.Authoring.Element.DetectOverrideHint: A ceiling on how far this Unit can Discover a concealed one.
FGT.Authoring.Element.RelationshipProxyH: Treats this Unit as somebody else for relationship questions.
FGT.Authoring.Element.ScriptHint: A named entry in a closed registry. Never `eval` — compendia are shared.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.applyEffectsHint: Puts effects onto whoever this ability caught — the commonest phase by far.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.damageHint: Deals damage to whoever this ability caught.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.cooldownHint: Changes a cooldown clock — its own, or somebody else's.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.resourceHint: Spends or grants a pool — tokens, counters, Sustainability.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.createFieldHint: Opens the bounded field this ability declares, once, from the caster.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.statChangeHint: Changes a stat directly, rather than through an effect.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.removeEffectHint: Strips effects off whoever this ability caught.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.healHint: Restores Health, as a flat amount or a fraction of MAXIMUM.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.summonHint: Brings a summon onto the board.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.checkHint: Rolls a check and branches on the result.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.chooseHint: Asks the player to pick from a list before continuing.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.rollTableHint: Rolls dice against a table and applies what comes up.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.itemGrantHint: Hands over a quantity of an item, possibly rolled.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.expendHint: Spends abilities for good — they do not come back off a cooldown.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.channelHint: Starts a channel: the Unit cannot act until it completes.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.dragIntoHint: Pulls a Unit into a bounded field.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.createStructureHint: Places a destructible object on the board.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.summonPlatformHint: Brings a platform out, with its own Scene Level.
FGT.Authoring.Phase.cutContractHint: Severs a Servant's contract with its Master.
FGT.Authoring.Req.inZonHint: Only while this Servant is inside its Master's ZON.
FGT.Authoring.Req.roundAtLeastHint: Only from a given Round onwards.
FGT.Authoring.Req.roundPhaseHint: Only during day, or only during night.
FGT.Authoring.Req.inZoneHint: Only while standing inside a named zone.
FGT.Authoring.Req.notInZoneHint: Only while standing outside a named zone.
FGT.Authoring.Req.hasSkillHint: Only while the Unit has a named ability.
FGT.Authoring.Req.modeActiveHint: Only while a named mode is switched on.
FGT.Authoring.Req.modeInactiveHint: Only while a named mode is switched off.
FGT.Authoring.Req.stanceHint: Only while mounted, or only while dismounted.
FGT.Authoring.Req.resourceAtLeastHint: Only while the Unit holds enough of a pool — tokens, counters.
FGT.Authoring.Req.healthBelowHint: Only while Health is below a fraction of its maximum.
FGT.Authoring.Req.healthAboveHint: Only while Health is above a fraction of its maximum.
FGT.Authoring.Req.healthRestoredSinceHin: Only if enough Health has been restored since this last fired.
FGT.Authoring.Req.masterHealthAboveHint: Only while the Master has more than a flat amount of Health.
FGT.Authoring.Req.masterHealthFractionHi: Only while the Master's Health is at least a fraction of its maximum.
FGT.Authoring.Req.counterpartAdjacentHin: Only while this Unit's counterpart is standing next to it.
FGT.Authoring.Req.targetHasEffectHint: Only while the target carries a named effect.
FGT.Authoring.Req.notHasEffectHint: Only while the Unit does NOT carry a named effect.
FGT.Authoring.Req.abilityOffCooldownHint: Only while the named abilities — or a whole group of them — are off cooldown.
FGT.Authoring.Req.itemAtLeastHint: Only while the Unit holds enough of a named item.
FGT.Authoring.Req.predicateHint: Only when a predicate holds — the general-purpose gate.
FGT.Authoring.Req.fieldOpenHint: Only while a named bounded field is open.
FGT.Authoring.Req.noAliveSummonHint: Only while a named summon of this Unit is not already on the board.
FGT.Authoring.Req.withinPlatformCentreHi: Only while standing in the middle of the platform this Unit is aboard.
FGT.Authoring.Req.servantInZonHint: Only while the Servant is inside its Master's ZON.
FGT.Authoring.Req.attackIsNotNPHint: Only when the attack being resolved is not a Noble Phantasm.
FGT.Authoring.Req.targetNotImmuneHint: Only while the Servant is not immune to what this command does.
FGT.Authoring.Req.servantWithinHint: Only while the Servant is within a number of panels of its Master.
FGT.Authoring.Req.servantNotWithinHint: Only while the Servant is further than a number of panels from its Master.
FGT.Authoring.Req.highRankMasterHint: Only for a Master who pays the High Rank column.
FGT.Authoring.Req.noOtherRevivalHint: Only if the Servant would not have come back anyway.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.servantInZonHint: Only while the Servant is inside its Master's ZON.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.attackIsNotNPHint: Only when the attack being resolved is not a Noble Phantasm.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.targetNotImmuneHint: Only while the Servant is not immune to what this command does.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.servantWithinHint: Only while the Servant is within a number of panels of its Master.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.servantNotWithinHint: Only while the Servant is further than a number of panels from its Master.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.highRankMasterHint: Only for a Master who pays the High Rank column.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.inZoneHint: Only while the Master, the Servant or the pair stands in a named zone.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.notInZoneHint: Only while not standing in a named zone — there is nothing to escape from at home.
FGT.Authoring.CsReq.noOtherRevivalHint: Only if the Servant would not have come back anyway.
FGT.Authoring.Window.ownTurnHint: During its owner's own Turn — the ordinary case, and the sheet button.
FGT.Authoring.Window.whenAttackedHint: When this Unit is attacked, as a reaction inside the attacker's Combat Process.
FGT.Authoring.Window.whenAllyAttackedHin: When an allied Unit nearby is about to be hit — the bearer is neither attacker nor defender.
FGT.Authoring.Window.damageStepHint: At the start of a Damage Step, on this Unit's OWN attack.
FGT.Authoring.Window.combatPhaseStartHin: At the start of a Combat Phase, on this Unit's own attack.
FGT.Authoring.Window.whenTargetedByNPHin: When a Noble Phantasm is DECLARED against this Unit, before any Combat Process exists.
FGT.Authoring.Timing.againstKindHint: Only against an attack of this kind — a Noble Phantasm, a Normal Attack, a Skill.
FGT.Authoring.Timing.againstRankHint: Only against an attack of this Rank or higher.
FGT.Authoring.Timing.requiresAoEHint: Only against an attack that covers an area, rather than one target.
FGT.Authoring.Timing.radiusHint: How far from this Unit the triggering attack may land and still open the window.
FGT.Authoring.Section.whatItIsHint: The ability's identity: its name, what kind of thing it is, and how it reads.
FGT.Authoring.Field.name: Name
FGT.Authoring.Field.nameHint: The name as it appears on the sheet and in chat.
FGT.Authoring.Field.kindHint: Class Skill, Personal Skill or Noble Phantasm.
FGT.Authoring.Field.rankHint: The Rank this ability is stated at — it drives every ranked table.
FGT.Authoring.Field.slugHint: The short internal name other content refers to this by.
FGT.Authoring.Field.npTagsHint: What kind of Noble Phantasm this is — barrier, anti-army, and so on.
FGT.Authoring.Field.descriptionHint: The sheet text, verbatim. Mark linkable names with @effect[] and @ability[].
FGT.Authoring.Section.limitsHint: Everything that stops this being used again immediately, or at all.
FGT.Authoring.Field.cooldown.maxHint: How long before it can be used again.
FGT.Authoring.Field.durationHint: How long what it does lasts, when the ability itself carries the clock.
FGT.Authoring.Field.costHint: What using it spends from the action budget.
FGT.Authoring.Field.maxUsesHint: How many times it may be used in the whole match. Blank means unlimited.
FGT.Authoring.Field.requiresRoundHint: The earliest Round it may be used in.
FGT.Authoring.Field.categoryHint: The group it belongs to, for clauses that name a whole category.
FGT.Authoring.Field.expendsPermanentlyHi: Spent for the rest of the game once used — not a cooldown, there is no number of Turns.
FGT.Authoring.Field.sameTurnExclusiveHin: Abilities that cannot be used in the same Turn as this.
FGT.Authoring.Field.sameRoundExclusiveHi: Abilities that cannot be used in the same Round as this.
FGT.Authoring.Field.exclusionSetHint: A named group whose members block one another.
FGT.Authoring.Field.alsoTriggersHint: Other abilities this use also puts on cooldown.
FGT.Authoring.Field.cooldownWaiverHint: A resource that can be spent to skip the cooldown entirely.
FGT.Authoring.Field.isPassiveHint: Always in effect — there is no active form to press.
FGT.Authoring.Field.isModeHint: Switched on and left on, rather than used.
FGT.Authoring.Field.toggleLockHint: How long after switching before it may be switched back.
FGT.Authoring.Field.cannotDeactivateHint: Once on, it never comes off.
FGT.Authoring.Field.isAttackSkillHint: Counts as an Attack as well as a Skill.
FGT.Authoring.Field.countsAsActHint: Counts as the Unit having Acted.
FGT.Authoring.Field.copyableHint: Whether another Servant's copy effect may take this.
FGT.Authoring.Section.npScopingHint: The three questions that decide whether the rules treat this as a Noble Phantasm.
FGT.Authoring.Field.isNPHint: It IS a Noble Phantasm — it costs its Master Health and answers the NP gate.
FGT.Authoring.Field.categorizedAsNPHint: Counted as one for clauses that ask, without being one.
FGT.Authoring.Field.npGateRoundHint: Its own Round gate, overriding the global one.
FGT.Authoring.Field.isSpellHint: A spell, for the clauses that care.
FGT.Authoring.Field.elementHint: Its element, where it has one.
FGT.Authoring.Section.whenItFiresHint: The moment this may be used — its own Turn, or a window inside somebody else's.
FGT.Authoring.Section.requirementsHint: Everything that must be true before it may be used. An unmet requirement refuses.
FGT.Authoring.Section.ruleElementsHint: What it does simply by existing — the passive half, and a mode's while-on half.
FGT.Authoring.Section.whereItLandsHint: Where the area is placed, what shape it is, and who inside it is caught.
FGT.Authoring.Section.whatItDoesHint: The phases that run when it is used, in order.
FGT.Authoring.Selection.relationsHint: Which Units in the area are caught — allies, enemies, or both.
FGT.Authoring.Selection.includeSelfHint: Whether the caster is caught by its own area.
FGT.Authoring.Selection.chooserHint: Who decides which of the caught Units are affected — everyone, or a pick.
FGT.Authoring.UnknownElement: No descriptor for this key — it may come from a module. Edited as raw JSON so it is never lost.

FGT.Authoring.Bucket.passiveRulesHint: Applies whenever the Unit has this ability at all.
FGT.Authoring.Bucket.activeRulesHint: Applies only while this is an active mode. Collected only when the ability is switched on.
FGT.Authoring.Bucket.rulesHint: Collected alongside the passive list; use it when neither of the other two reads more clearly.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.typeHint: Is a Servant, a Master, a Summon, a Platform, a Structure or a Civilian.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.contentIdHint: Is one named Unit specifically, by its content id.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.attributeHint: Carries a named Attribute — Large, Divine, Undead, Outsider.

FGT.Predicate.Facet.freeHint: Has no Master: the Servant is Free or Unbound.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.masterTierHint: The Master pays the High Rank column, the Low one, or is Rankless.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.effectHint: Is currently carrying a named effect.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.effectFamilyHint: Is carrying any effect from a named family.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.skillHint: Has a named Skill at all, active or not.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.skillActiveHint: Has a named mode switched ON — not merely possessing it.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.skillRankHint: Has a named Skill at a given Rank or better.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.rankHint: A Parameter stands at a given grade or better.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.highestParameterHint: A named Parameter is this Unit's highest.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.npAboveAllParameters: The Noble Phantasm's rank is above every one of this Unit's Parameters.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.paramVsSelfHint: The target's Parameter compared against the caster's own.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.stableDieHint: A die face derived from the Unit's id — the same answer every time.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.stanceHint: Is mounted, or dismounted — Achilles's whole sheet turns on it.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.regionHint: The war is being fought in a named Region.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.phaseHint: Only during the day, or only during the night.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.inHomeBaseHint: Is standing inside its own faction's Home Base.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.inFieldHint: Is standing inside a named bounded field.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.fieldActiveHint: A named bounded field is open somewhere on the board.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.sourceHint: The revival that just fired came from a named source.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.reactionHint: Reacted to this attack in a named way, or declined to react.
FGT.Reaction.EvadeNoRoll: Evade is declared but not rolled: this attack is worsened instead.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.terrainHint: Is standing in a named type of Terrain.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.withinOfOwnerMasterH: Is within a number of panels of its own Master.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.kindHint: The attack is a Normal Attack, a Skill or a Noble Phantasm.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.isAoEHint: The attack covers an area rather than one target.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.componentHint: The attack uses Base Attack (STR) or Base Attack (MAG).
FGT.Predicate.Facet.elementHint: The attack deals damage of a named element.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.npScaleHint: The Noble Phantasm is of a given scale or larger — Anti-Army and above.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.vsAttributeHint: The attack is one that hits a named Attribute especially hard.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.ignoresMagicResistan: The attack is one Magic Resistance does not see.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.thrownWeaponHint: The attack is made with a thrown weapon.
FGT.Predicate.Facet.rangeHint: How far away the target is, exactly or as a threshold.
